bayts.text: My poems have stirred the hearts of the bearers of the Throne, and they are glad tidings for the perfect.
When I write, the Throne of the King trembles, and every angel trembles with glorification.
That is the grace of Allah (Qurʾān 62:4) — how excellent is Allah, my Lord! — and there is no god but Allah.
Truly my writing, with Allah, puts to shame the people of disbelief and of frivolous amusements.
The Best of mankind has extended to my breast what has kept my life from the idle prattle of the Whisperer (Qurʾān 114:4).
He has banished the devils and what is allied with them toward other than my harm: I worship God.
The Most Generous has honoured me with the Qurʾān, and has bestowed on me the watering-place of the thirsty.
No insinuation has come near me, nor madness, nor turbidity, nor calamity, nor oppression.
No devil comes near my gathering, and the passage (of exile) and the homelands have become pleasant to me.
He Who led my writing to the Footstool (Al-Kursī) has honoured me with His hidden secret.
The gifts of the Lord of the Throne and of the Footstool have purified my life with what is holy.
When I recite, rewards yield to my life, and I commit no injustice.
My tongue has sheltered, like my heart and body, from superfluous things, and my merchandise sold (to God) has not lain unsold.
Toward me my King has led my prices; for me life has become good, like the times.
My writing has taken the place of weapons and of raids, for the people of righteousness.
My being a servant of Allah has become manifest to me, and through it an attendant of the Messenger of Allah.
He has extended to me the guarded secret Who made my writing His greatest good pleasure, and so it was.
The Most Generous, the Honourer, has honoured me, and toward others than me the countless host has fled.
To my King I have led, by the towering ships (Qurʾān 55:24), what sweeps away ruin.
I have led, amid the army and the troops, what drives off ships and waves.
He has turned my harm toward the one who schemed before, He Who, among His hosts, has appreciated my (spiritual) struggle.
He leads reward to me without scale, He Whose hosts have been gladdened by my adornments.
My degree, without guile, rises, and I benefit from the reward of my Lord.
The gifts of Him Who is exalted above all likeness yield to me, (gifts) that remained hidden from (my) peers.
Rewards yield to me, for the Garden of Allah, and I head toward nothing but good: I commit no injustice.
Allah guided me in my exile, and led to me, in writing, the best of means of drawing near.
He has honoured me in that my writing is, with Him, among what He boasts of before His hosts in the Gardens.
My writing has driven the Accursed toward others than me, and the Helper (Al-Muʿīn) has driven him toward other than my life.
My poems have stirred the hearts of the prophets, together with the angels, with my Lord.
My poems are among the miracles of the Chosen One: may He bless him Who guided and chose him.
The Most Holy (Al-Quddūs) has purified me of impurities, and al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) has led to me (followers) from (all) races.
My knowledge has led me to gratitude and righteousness, and success has yielded to me without guile.
Allah has honoured me in that I have as beloved ones the bearers of His Throne and the perfect.
